milestones.name: Obtain Crystal Heart
milestones.note: Found on the left side of Crystal Peak; grants the Super Dash ability

milestones.name: Unlock Super Dash
milestones.note: Activated upon acquiring the Crystal Heart; allows crossing large distances without losing height

zones.name: Crystal Peak
zones.fingerprintHint: Purple crystalline caverns with scaffold frameworks, spike-covered flip platforms, conveyor belts, and lasers; deep purple/violet lighting throughout

zones.name: Forgotten Crossroads
zones.fingerprintHint: Entry zone connecting to Crystal Peak via toll booth hallway or Desolate Dive mine shaft breach

abilities.name: Crystal Heart
abilities.note: Hold the bound button to charge (crystals grow and glow), release to propel the Knight forward horizontally at full speed until hitting an enemy, hazard, or pressing the button again

abilities.name: Mothwing Cloak
abilities.note: Required prerequisite to access Crystal Heart

abilities.name: Mantis Claw
abilities.note: Required prerequisite to access Crystal Heart

abilities.name: Lumafly Lantern
abilities.note: One of two alternative prerequisites (alongside Desolate Dive) needed to access Crystal Peak / Crystal Heart

abilities.name: Desolate Dive
abilities.note: Alternative prerequisite to Lumafly Lantern; used to destroy the floor of a mine shaft at the top-left of Forgotten Crossroads to enter Crystal Peak

objectives.name: Reach Crystal Peak via Forgotten Crossroads toll booth
objectives.hopDescription: Navigate to the left-side hallway of Forgotten Crossroads and pay the toll booth (requires Lumafly Lantern to see and pay it)

objectives.name: Reach Crystal Peak via Desolate Dive shortcut
objectives.hopDescription: Use Desolate Dive to break the floor of the mine shaft at the top-left of Forgotten Crossroads, above the toll gate

objectives.name: Navigate to Crystal Heart room in Crystal Peak
objectives.hopDescription: Head to the top of Crystal Peak, go left into the tall-ceiling room, then take the rightmost downward path to a large Golem with a lever; hit the lever for a shortcut, then enter the Crystal Heart area to the right
objectives.note: The Crystal Heart room features flip platforms with spike crystals underneath, conveyor belts, lasers, and enemies. Pogoing crystals with the nail flips platforms back upright. Crystals are not environmental hazards, so i-frames from damage allow standing on them.

connectors.description: Left-side hallway with a toll booth; only visible and payable with Lumafly Lantern
Mine shaft at top-left of Forgotten Crossroads above the toll gate; floor destroyed using Desolate Dive
Golem with a lever near the top of Crystal Peak; hitting the lever opens a shortcut leading right to the Crystal Heart platforming area
